https://asphalt9.assets.gameloft.com/assets/UP_46_Patch_Header_f4e14fd401.pngAlthough we rarely do this, a new Update is coming this season, to introduce one of our most ambitious features to date: EVO Tuning! 
    EVO TUNING 
    https://asphalt9.assets.gameloft.com/assets/EV_Otuning_82bd347470.png

    Our brand new feature adds a new layer of tuning and power for some classic cars! 

    For our first foray, EVO Tuning will be available for the Bugatti Chiron, the Ferrari Enzo Ferrari and the Chevrolet Camaro LT. 

    Once you max these cars, you will automatically unlock the new EVO feature and be able to access it directly from the garage. 

    The EVO feature will allow you to collect new items that unlock new driving experiences for your car: 
            Collect Items: Each car will have access to its own EVO shop, allowing you to unlock EVO items such as new engines, drivetrains, nitro systems, etc.                 Create your build: Each item will have a different weight, and the total weight of your car will heavily impact how it performs on the track.                 Fine Tuning: Specific items can provide boosts to key areas, so adapt your choice to your driving style!     
    We'll be looking forward to all your feedback and impressions in our Discord Channel to help us fine tune and balance this feature so it can evolve it into something special. 

    Yes. Pun fully intended. See you in Discord! 
https://youtu.be/lnKrRYPMaAk
    EVO SHOP 
    https://asphalt9.assets.gameloft.com/assets/EV_Oshop_826f5d117e.png

    When accessing the new EVO Tuning menus, you'll have direct acces to the new EVO Shop. 

    It will feature all the available EVO Items for that car from the start, and you'll be able to spend tickets to choose which Item to reveal and keep first! 

    A bit of luck and you'll have your dream build in no time! 

    4 EVO Shop tickets for that car will be automatically earned as soon as you Max your car. 

    You'll be able to earn more tickets through gameplay, the shop and we even included some in the Legend Pass! 
    LEGO TECHNIC SPOTLIGHT 
    https://asphalt9.assets.gameloft.com/assets/LEGO_spotlight_2954341097.png

    One last sprint alongside LEGO Technic! 

    The new Spotlight event for the season will feature all our released LEGO Technic cars, for you to complete or try to unlock if you're late to the party! 

    Keep an eye out for some special TLEs during the season to get a chance to compete for your very own LEGO Technic Sets!

    A season of celebrations begins, as this year marks 20 Years of Asphalt! 

    And before the celebrations begin, we wanted to give all our Legends a MASSIVE THANK YOU! 

    Without you we would have never been able to make this far, and whether you've been with us for 20 years, 20 days or even 20 minutes, we want to thank you for joining us in this amazing journey!

    Now, it's time to buckle up as we're going to take you a nostalgic trip through time.... and space! 

    First, we need to go back to where it all began: 
    ASPHALT URBAN GT 
    https://asphalt9.assets.gameloft.com/assets/Asphalt_Urban_GT_Artwork_Key_Visual_logo_1579x1114_338a46cd49.png

    We've brought our first ever Asphalt game back for the Anniversary! You'll be able to experience our first steps (or laps) for yourself and see how far we've come. 

    Head over to our website once the season starts, and take the old beauty out for a spin. Who knows? You might even get a reward for finishing. 
    SAN DIEGO HARBOR TRACK REMAKE 
https://youtu.be/SIvowekmW2Y

    We bring back one of the classic tracks from Asphalt 8... but with a twist! Mysterious teleporters have appeared that will take you through space and time. 

    Not only will you be able to experience a fully re-rendered version of San Diego, but also make a pit stop in the L.A. River with a quick detour through our beloved Cairo track. 

    In case you missed it, check out our exclusive track reveal. 
    20th ANNIVERSARY SPOTLIGHT
    https://asphalt9.assets.gameloft.com/assets/annispot_66f5015366.png

    We've had to get bigger light bulbs for this one, just to be able to shine a light on all the cars included! 

    We're featuring 20 classic Asphalt cars for you to race with, and you can check the full list in our event preview below. 

    The Anniversary event will also feature a Spotlight Pass, including some specially themed Anniversary decals! 
    CELEBRATE WITH US! 
    Not only do we have great events in-game but there's also more goodies to be had by joining our community: 
            FREE CODES: Not only do you get some freebies just for logging in during the anniversary, but we'll be celebrating 20 Days of Free Codes on our socials! Make sure to follow!                 ANNIVERSARY ACE CHALLENGE: You've already seen our qualifiers as we gear up to the Grand Finals on August 15th! Don't miss the show for more free codes!         DRIVE SYNDICATE 12 
    https://asphalt9.assets.gameloft.com/assets/ds12_b41dec5638.png

    The latest entry in the Drive Syndicate saga and featuring one of the most powerful line-ups in history! 

    Take the wheel of the Arash Imperium and experience what it truly means to dominate the streets. 
    NEW CUSTOMIZATION SYSTEM 
    https://asphalt9.assets.gameloft.com/assets/custom_e6adcc23ea.png

    As we previewed last season, we're introducing a new way to unlock your customizations! 

    Instead of having to complete specific tasks to unlock customizations, you'll now be able to earn Style Tokens by playing normally and use them to unlock the customizations of your choice, allowing you more freedom to play what you enjoy while still being able to unlock what you want.

            30 Blueprints for the Pagani Zonda Cinque                 Legend Pass                15 Legend Pass Tiers                 5 Wildcard Blueprints for each Class                 15 Seasonal Card Packs                 +5 Extra Fuel                 500 Style Tokens                 10,000 Tokens                 20,000,000 Credits                 5,000 VIP XP                 100% boost to RP gains                 100% boost to TC gains     
     
    Legend Pass Changes 
    As promised in our Roadmap, we're bumping up the Legend Pass with boosted rewards and without changing the price. 

    You'll be able to fully appreciate the changes once the update is live but here's a quick summary of changes: 
            Increased total Credits awarded from 3,130,000 to 6,630,000.                 Increased total Tokens awarded from 1,250 to 3,000.                Increased Blueprints awarded for the 6 featured cars from 5 to 8 BP. (Unite Pass Car unlock remains unchanged)                 The Body Kit Card Packs awarded have been changed to Seasonal Card packs and increased from 2 to 5 packs.                 Wildcard Blueprints have been increased to 3 for all classes.         Multiplayer Changes 
    We're opening the doors to our World Series for a final hurrah before the reset. 
    World Series Changes             5th Round + Bonus Round: This season will feature one last round and a Bonus round as we prepare for a new MP reset next season.                 Car filters: We're removing all the car filters and the free try cars. It's time to prove if you have the garage to match your skills!          Season Series 
    Green Streak Changes: We've been playing close attention to the feedback on the new mode, and we're going to be boosting the amount of Nitro included in the green bottles accross the board. 1st placed drivers should notice a significanty improvement to their nitro gains, as it will offer a closer experience to driving in a normal race, and those coming in last will receive a MUCH larger nitro boost than before. Hopefully these changes will make the mode more enjoyable, and we'll continue to keep an eye on your feedback as always. 
    Overall Changes 
    Increased Season Score gains in smaller lobbies: We've boosted the amount of series score gained when participating in lobbies which are not full, as players have shared they are facing smaller lobbies of players in multiplayer, particularly in the higher leagues. 
    More accessible Import Parts 
    To make it easier to upgrade your cars, you'll now be able to directly purchase with tokens any missing common or rare Import Parts directly from the upgrade screen! 

     https://asphalt9.assets.gameloft.com/assets/image_50_835e85ebbf.png
    Shop changes 
    We're introducing 2 new quality of life changes in our shop, to make it easier to navigate and less cumbersome overall: 
            Multipacks: We're bundling up offers for the same car to help save some space. Now you'll be able to select the cars in the shop, and you will be shown a pop-up that includes all the offers available for that car.                 Car filter and Search: Looking for deals for your favorite car? Now you'll be able to search the shop and display any available offers for the car of your choice!        Aptoide Support
    We will no longer be supporting the Aptoide store for Android.

    If you downloaded Asphalt Legends from their storefront, please make sure to have your account linked in the CONNECT screen of the settings menu, to ensure your progress isn't lost when reinstalling.

notes.title: Korean Spring Season Update
notes.notes:
We have a special update coming up, packing 2 seasons, and one of our most awaited game modes: The Gauntlet!

This update is also packed with new features such as the new VIP system, Event Spotlights, new Unlock and Reward animations, and a new exclusive MP car, and much more!

Our 2 new Seasons will also each feature their own special guest stars, as Hyundai will be headlining our Korean Spring Season, and we'll let you guess who will be joining the following Toyota & Lexus Season.

Gauntlet Mode

It's finally happening! The Gauntlet is coming to Asphalt Legends Unite!

A new competitive mode that will have you set a time on 5 random tracks with your best cars, and challenge other player's times to rise up the ranks!
With League, Rank and Daily rewards to collect, our star prize for our top racers will be none other than the Devel Sixteen.

Don't miss out on our exclusive playthrough for a sneak peek on what to expect.

Exclusive MP Car

We continue to make our multiplayer even better! You'll now be able to unlock an exclusive Multiplayer car, the Ford GT Mk IV, by progressing through your milestones and ranking up in multiplayer events!

New VIP System

Level up through our new VIP system to earn permanent bonuses for your account. More details below.

New Spotlights

A new style of events! Get straight into the action with Free Try Cars available and tracks changing each day, the challenge will be to try and get your hands on as many Spotlight Collectibles as you can! 
These will earn you Spotlight Coins which you can trade in for the rewards of your choice each event! 
Make sure to get your rewards before the Spotlight ends, as Spotlight Coins will convert to credits once the event ends.

Korean Spring Season Preview

A new season with very special guests, the brand new Hyundai IONIQ 5 N and Hyundai N Vision 74 Concept!

Special Events:

Drive Syndicate 11: Blue Shadows - The SCC Tuatara Striker will be the star of a new Drive Syndicate! Sprint through the new chapters with the Hyundai IONIQ 5 N, the Ferrari Monza SP1, the Puritalia Berlinetta, Aston Martin Valhalla, and Bugatti La Voiture Noire.
Korean Food Festival SE: The Korean Food Festival makes a spicy return, featuring the Ford Shelby GT350R, the Renault Sport R.S. 01, the Chevrolet Corvette Stingray, the Chevrolet Corvette Grand Sport, the Ford GT Mk II, the Puritalia Berlinetta, and the Porsche 911 GT3 RS
Easter Eggstravaganza Spotlight: Our first ever Spotlight event, featuring the Bugatti Chiron Pur Sport, the Pininfarina Battista Edizione Nino Farina, the Lamborghini Invencible, Porsche Mission R, and the TVR Griffith.
LEGO Technic Chevrolet Corvette Stingray Collector Hunt: For those who missed out, LEGO Technic is back for a victory lap!
Hyundai N Vision 74 Concept GP: Our latest Grand Prix will feature one of our new Hyundai stars!

Time Limited Events:

Hyundai Experience Round 1:  Will feature both the electrifying Hyundai IONIQ 5 and the Hyundai N Vision 74 Concept for an introductory spin.
Bugatti Veyron Boss Mode: Boss mode makes a return featuring the Bugatti Veyron 16.4 Grand Sport Vitesse.
Star Hunt: Get behind the McLaren 570S Spider and reach for the stars! (Or finish line, whichever is closer)
Hyundai Experience Round 2: A new Hyundai TLE, this time starring the N Vision 74 Concept.
Gameloft Anniversary: It's our Birthday! Come celebrate in style with the Mercedes Vision One-Eleven, McLaren Solus GT, and the Arrinera Hussarya 33.
Epic Hunt: Done with the Star Hunt? Continue with the Epic Hunt for the McLaren 570S Spider. Go the Unite Pass? Grand! You'll be able to earn extra Epic Import parts for the Mclaren!
Hyundai Experience Round 3: The last limited time event will feature the Hyundai IONIQ 5 N.
April Rides: Our rides of the month will feature the Ferrari 599XX EVO, the McLaren Senna GTR and the Ferrari LaFerrari.
Earth Day: Lasting more than just its namesake, this event will feature the Pininfarina Battista, the DS E-TENSE Performance and the Pininfarina H2 Speed.
Golden Week: Celebrate the holidays with the Nissan GT-R Nismo, the Nissan 370z Neon Edition, and the Nissan 370z Nismo.
Car hunts: This season we'll feature in order: the Puritalia Berlinetta, the Chevrolet Corvette Stingray, the TVR Sagaris (Legend Hunt), the McLaren Senna GTR, and the Bugatti EB110 (Key Hunt).

Extra Info:



VIP System

A new VIP system is coming to Asphalt Legends Unite, allowing players to earn VIP Experience points in-game and progress through a series of 10 VIP levels, each unlocking permanent rewards for your account!

You'll be able to earn VIP experience in all sorts of ways, including daily gifts, through events, as Unite Pass rewards and also VIP experience points will be included in bundles in our store.

Here are the permanent account bonuses you'll unlock at each level:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42598558/7a1e0008c2210ed7d4fce442fa35261c4a0e2901.jpg

Being a VIP will also unlock a free Daily VIP Card Pack which you can claim directly from the VIP menu.

We'll continue to work and expand on this system in the future, but first we look forward to hearing your thoughts on our Discord.

Multiplayer Changes

Apart from the new exclusive MP car, the Ford GT MK IV, which you will be able to unlock and upgrade by participating in our events, we're bringing a few more changes to our Multiplayer experience.

Event Demotions: After each MP1 event, players ranked Gold III or above will be demoted to Gold IV at the start of each new event. This will now provide our most dedicated players with a whole 3 Divisions to progress through each event, alongside the rewards provided through ranking up again.
Improved Event End Rewards: We've also boosted the rewards provided at the end of each event for your final leader board position and rank to make it each event more rewarding!
Unified Rewards: In order to allow for a more focused grind towards unlocking our featured cars, we will no longer be including Blueprints for the Free Try Cars in our rewards.

New RETRY Button

Another big Community request, we've introduced a new "Retry" button to our in-race pause menu, allowing you to restart the race directly, without needing to first exit and then re-enter the race. 

New UI Animations

We've spruced up some of our menu animations, adding some extra shine and dazzle to our most special moments, such as Unlocking a new Car, opening card packs or receiving rewards. 

Have a look and let us know your thoughts in Discord.

Club Access Resolved

Our Legends will now be able to leave clubs once more, allowing for Club management and recruitment efforts to resume as normal. 

Android Performance

Improved performance on certain devices, particularly those using Adreno GPUs.

Car Balancing - Mercedes-Benz CLK-GTR Buff

This car is currently underperforming compared to other cars in a similar rank, particularly in our Season Series, where car rank takes more prevalence in matchmaking.

For this reason we'll be boosting its Nitro and Handling stats at Stock, while also giving a slight increase to Nitro at Max.

Asphalt Legends Unite is launching on Wednesday, July 17th. We’re finally unveiling to the world everything we’ve been working on for the past years, and the team couldn’t be more excited. 

Here’s all the new features, all the new game modes, all the new cars, and all the new seasons headed your way for the release of Asphalt Legends Unite. 

Cross-Platform

Cross-play and cross-save will be activated at last. Take on the world as you’ll be able to play against any friend or foe that crosses your path. With cross-play, all our racers will manage to race against anyone, no matter their platform, making for a faster and more competitive multiplayer experience. 

You’ll also be able to switch devices yourself, as cross-save will be active across select platforms, allowing you to quickly jump from one platform to another seamlessly. 

New Friends List and Private Lobbies  

Keeping track and playing with your friends has never been easier! Add your regular co-pilots to your friends list and invite them to a private race with our new Private Lobbies, 

You’ll be able to invite up to 7 other friends, choose your track, and race any car you own to prove once and for all who the best racer is. No fuel or tickets required. 

New Track – Singapore  

We have an all-new track for you to explore, inspired by the beautiful city of Singapore. 

You’ll be able to drive through its vibrant nightlife, as you race amongst city lights, swerve through an amusement park , and speed down water slides to reach the finish line. 

New Co-op Game Mode – Team Pursuit   

In Asphalt Legends Unite, we’re giving you the first-ever opportunity to team up with other racers to achieve victory. 

Get thrown into this epic chase, by taking part as either the Syndicate Team or the Security Team. 

The Syndicate drivers will be faced with using their guile and teamwork to escape the chasing security forces. You’ll have to put your skills on display to avoid getting taken down and reaching the finish line. 

On the other hand, the Security drivers will be going all in to take down the escaping Security drivers. They’ll have to coordinate their movements to set the perfect trap and not allow the syndicate drivers to escape. 

Get ready for some exciting chases and unhinged mayhem! 

Improved Game – Engine  

Thanks to a Gameloft team effort, we’ve spent some time under the hood to give our game a big upgrade. 

With the inclusion of Dynamic Light effects and improved light reflections, Asphalt Legends Unite delivers a new layer of realism. 

The new Singapore track will be a wonderful place to showcase all the improvements, as the dazzling night lights reflect against the hood of your car or your new car’s headlights shine ahead of you, Asphalt has never looked better. 

The Beginning of a New Multiplayer  
With the launch of unite we'll also be expanding our multiplayer system, with the main objective of providing a better experience and welcome the new cross-platform era. We'll be introducing 2 new permanent events, World League and Season Series, offering both a revamped competitive mode and a new more casual experience. 

We plan to continue improving multiplayer on future updates, all while paying close attention to community feedback to keep improving the MP experience! 

New Garage Level Cap  

We're also increasing the game's Garage Level cap to 60! Progress through Collector Stages I & II to unlock extra daily card packs for you to claim each day!

Other changes:
 
New Multiplayer Changes 

The launch of Unite along with cross-play functionality has brought a renewed focus on multiplayer. From now on, we want our Multiplayer mode to feel more dynamic and varied, as we include regular updates to ensure it feels fresh and exciting. 

Of course, we’ll be paying close attention to player feedback to make sure our changes are hitting the right notes. 

On release, we’ll be introducing 2 new permanent Multiplayer Modes: World League, and Season Series. 

World League
 
Our core competitive mode. More veteran players will recognize this as our expansion on our classic World Series. With all our players uniting under one roof, and having more players competing together, we knew we needed to expand our current multiplayer and breathe some new life into it, as our players have been requesting for some time. 

The main changes coming to our competitive mode are: 


Car Filters: Not all cars will be available to compete, and we’ll be changing our car rosters from event to event to keep them fresh. We also won’t be grouping cars solely based on car class, but more based on their car rank. This will allow for more balanced and interesting car selections 
Sub-tiers: As we get ready for all our players to finally compete together, each tier will be broken into Sub-tiers, allowing for a larger number of players to compete and still provide meaningful progression. 
New format Structure: The World League will offer the competitive experience year-round over a total of 6 Splits in the following structure: 
Rounds: Competitive events lasting 2 weeks. Once complete you'll be able to claim your rewards for the Round and all players will be slightly demoted before the next round starts. 
Split: A grouping made of 4 Rounds. Will aslo grant greater rewards upon completion and players will also be dropped in ranks before the next split starts.


Once a new round starts, players will start their competitive climb, gaining ranks as usual based on your performance. 

Once the round ends, you'll be able to claim the final Round rewards. Player's total rank will also be slightly reduced before the next Round begins. Don't worry, you'll only lose a few sub tiers and won't be demoted entire Tiers at a time. 

Once a Split ends, you'll be able to claim the final Split reards, based on your perfomance over the past 4 Rounds. After a split players will also suffer a demotion. 

The end goal of course is to see how high you can climb within the competitive year! At the start of a new competitive year all competitive progress will be reset, and you'll be back to defend your claim for another year. 

You can also expect to see a few changes in rules, settings and car rotations each round, but we'll share more info on that once we're closer to the events themselves, so keep your eyes peeled. 

These changes will allow for a more finely grained level of competition, given our increase in players, and provide a longer progression system for all. 

The inclusion of Sub-Tiers will also allow for more accurate matchmaking, along with allowing us to reward players each step of the way as they unlock unique rewards and additions to the car filter. It might be a longer goal to aim for, but we’ll make it worth it every step of the way. 

Furthermore, changing our philosophy on car filters will let us break the barriers of class filters and allow for some unique matchups yet to be seen in a competitive environment. 

We hope this will also allow for a more new-player friendly introduction to the competitive series, while allowing more balanced and epic matchups in our higher Tiers. 

Season Series 

A new multiplayer series that allows for a more casual experience! 

Here we want to offer a more relaxed and open experience, free from restrictions and car filters and allowing you to face the rest of the Asphalt Community with anything you have in your garage. 

Of course, we will still be matchmaking you against cars with a similar rank, but you’ll be free to practice on whichever car you own and get some action on your favorite rides. 

These events will last a week, and offer rewards based on your series score.

Dodge Viper ACR 
Coming in Season 2: Nio EP9 


Speeders 
We're also seeing a new event feature releasing with Asphalt Legends Unite: Speeders! 

On select events, keep an eye out for speeder pads: colorful pads placed on the track that will immediately give you a boost if you race over them. Take full advantage if you want to take 1st place, but careful not to crash! 

Balancing Changes 
The team will be undertaking a new balancing project that will span several updates. Throughout this and future updates, we'll be tweaking the stats and perfomance of a few cars, both applying buffs and nerfs to a few outstanding car's whose performance does not seem to represent the car's garage rating. 

We will make sure to keep you updated via our regular patch notes of any changes coming each update. 

For this update the team will be adjusting 2 cars: 

Devel Sixteen: Fixed several physics bugs that were affecting car perfomance. 
Dev notes: As reported by our community, given the this car's singular shape and acceleration, the car could behave in an undesired way in certain circumstances. With these fixes, the car should be able to behave more predictively and make it more intuitive to drive. It should help set more consistent times in your races, with the car behaving more as it was intended. 
 
Hennessey Venom F5: The Nitro stat has been slightly lowered to 24.07 stock and 46.00 at Max.
Dev notes: This is a small nerf to bring it more in line with it's ranking in game. We felt the Nitro was a bit too high far a car with that top speed, and this should bring its performance more in line with expectations.
 

Nintendo Switch Bank 

As Nintendo will also be switching over to the global version of Asphalt Legends Unite, their Bank feature will also be adapted to the new global standard. For this reason, Bank progress will need to be reset on Nintendo Switch, and the team will be sending the appropriate compensation to any affected accounts. 

We're sorry for the inconvenience and thank you for your understanding. 

Device Support Changes: 

Due to the increased performance requirements of the new ingame engine, we will be dropping support all the devices that have no Vulkan API support. If you require the full list of such devices, please contact Customer Care.

Special Events:

Its Special Event will kick off with a max free try stage of the main car, so anyone can get a feel for it! To progress, you’ll need the Pagani Zonda HP Barchetta (featured in a parallel key hunt), the McLaren F1 LM, Spania 2015 GTA Spano, Peugeot 9x8, Zenvo TSR-S, and the brand-new Grand Prix car, the Maserati GT2.

 SSC Tuatara Special Event is back! Unlock or level up your owned SSC Tuatara, along with the SE support cars.  
 Maserati GT2 will hit the tracks in a dedicated Grand Prix event. Don’t forget that it’s a support car in the Lotus E-R9 SE!  
 The McLaren Speedtail Starway returns!

 Kicking off the new season with some light exercise in the Running Green TLE, featuring the Apex AP-0.  
 Cruise in the Porsche 911 GTS Coupé within the Coastal Cruising TLE.  
 The Dragon Boat TLE returns, featuring the iconic Ferrari F8 Tributo.  
 Showcase your skills in the Endurance Showdown TLE on Paris, featuring the Ferrari F50, McLaren GT, and Ford GT. 
 Revel in the sunshine for longer than usual in the Summer Solstice TLE!  
 The Overclock and Season Showcase TLEs will be present, as always. Remember to collect your Overclock chips!  
 Defeat your opponents in the Legend Pass Car TLE Showcase, featuring the sleek Aston Martin DB12!

The Apex AP-0 will be featured in a parallel hunt to the Unleashed event, so worry not if you don’t own it yet!  
 The Starway rotation will continue with the Lamborghini Huracán Evo Spyder Event!  
 Missed it the first time? The Ferrari 296 GTB Grand Prix will rerun! Do you have what it takes to win against the competition?  


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42598558/fdf58e3a1f541ec058ded8a14013010b6f050dcd.png

Time-Limited Events:

 Get your wheels ready! It’s time to Race Across France in the Vision 1789 in Paris.  
 Setting some time aside from grilling to celebrate 4th of July in style, with American cars in their dedicated TLE.  
 Celebrate our shared love for gaming in the Gaming Galore TLE! This one’s dedicated to all the new Legends that are joining us!  Numbers Galore is what you’ll say once you see the car list for this Lucky Number 7 TLE!  
 The Overclock and Season Showcase TLEs will be present, as always. Remember to collect your Overclock chips!

 Season’s car/key hunts (in order): Glickenhaus 004c, Ferrari Roma, Apex AP-0, Peugeot SR1.

   On May 29th, at 12:00 CEST, Asphalt 9: Legends will be undergoing maintenance on the Windows, Xbox, and Steam versions of the game, so please make sure you claim your event rewards before then or they will be lost.

The cars available for Overclocking each Season can change and are ensured to include some useful picks that will surely be helpful in the upcoming events.
